system.description:
Elf

Elves are slender, graceful demi-humans, slightly shorter than humans and averaging between 4½ and 5 feet in height. They are known for their keen senses, natural affinity with magic, and mastery of both sword and spell. Elves do not sleep but instead enter a meditative trance.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Dexterity: +1
  • Constitution: −1

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 60 feet.
  • Resistance to Sleep and Charm: 90% immunity to sleep spells and +2 bonus on saving throws vs. charm and hold spells.
  • Detect Secret and Concealed Doors: Elves within 10 feet of a secret or concealed door have a 1-in-6 chance of noticing it passively, 2-in-6 when actively searching.
  • Move Silently: Elves can move silently in non-metal armor, surprising opponents on a 1–4 on a d6 in natural settings.
  • Weapon Proficiency Bonus: Elves receive a +1 bonus to attack rolls with bows of all types and with the short or long sword.
  • Woodland Stealth: Elves are difficult to spot in forests, effectively invisible when motionless.

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Magic-User, Thief, Fighter/Magic-User, Fighter/Thief, Magic-User/Thief, Fighter/Magic-User/Thief.
